headword: {寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A train equipped with sleeping berths or compartments, allowing passengers to sleep during overnight journeys.

examples.japanese: {寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, the number of sleeper trains has decreased dramatically.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧だ。
examples.english: A fond memory from my childhood is riding a sleeper train with my family to Hokkaido.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{寝台|しんだい}→寝台：04208_shindai⟧ (bed; sleeping berth) and ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (train). Once a common mode of long-distance travel in Japan, most sleeper trains have been discontinued due to competition from the ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧ (bullet train) and domestic airlines. The luxury cruise train サンライズ{瀬戸|せと}・⟦{出雲|いずも}→出雲：30792_izumo⟧ (Sunrise Seto/Izumo) between Tokyo and western Japan is one of the few remaining regular services.

- {寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: a sleeper train journey
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧{寝台列車|しんだいれっしゃ}: luxury sleeper train
